title: Full-width transformation
prompt: Create a high-fidelity desktop WEBSITE DESIGN MOCKUP for Etymon, an open-source CLI that keeps coding-agent setup portable. Render the actual web page edge to edge at landscape 1536 x 1024, no outer browser frame, no device, no perspective, no desk, no mockup annotations. Clean modern minimalist product showcase with developer character, generous whitespace, confident precise typography. Manrope-style geometric sans for UI/display, monospace only for actual commands/file paths. Large 80-90px hero type, real readable small text, restrained orange accent #ea6b35, near-white #fafaf8 and charcoal #202326. Avoid neon, cyberpunk, hacker styling, gradients, glassmorphism, stock illustrations, equal-sized feature card grids, invented pricing/testimonials/stats, badges/eyebrows over headings, em dashes, filler marketing language. Sticky slim navbar: orange abstract geometric mark and lowercase wordmark "etymon" on the left; links "Workflow", "Interfaces", "Tools" on the right; accessible theme toggle sun/moon icon and GitHub mark icon without GitHub text. Main hero heading exact: "One setup.\nEvery coding tool." Main subcopy: "Keep your skills, MCP servers, agents, and rules together. Take them to the tools you already use." Main CTA is a copyable compact terminal command "npx etymon" with copy icon. Include secondary "Read the guide" link. The signature product graphic is an attractive flat terminal and file-browser split UI, not a screenshot of an IDE and not a hardware object. Four compact workflow controls: "init", "convert", "sync", "skills add", plus a pause icon. Its terminal uses real command "etymon convert claude" and short success lines; its file-browser shows ".agents", "etymon.toml", "etymon.lock", "etymon/rules", "etymon/skills". Show small explanatory label "Illustrative demo" and subtle factual note "Original files stay until you remove them." Native files being superseded are CLAUDE.md, .claude/rules, .mcp.json; file movement should read as a frozen frame of an elegant motion graphic. Include the beginning of a separate section below with heading "Bring the whole setup." and the interface names "Skills", "MCP", "Agents", "Rules & instructions". Produce finished visual art direction that could be implemented as semantic responsive HTML, CSS, and animated geometric UI. All controls look genuinely usable; all copy concise and human. COMPOSITION B, DARK MODE: Charcoal #171a1d page with off-white typography, warm orange accent. Set the hero headline large across the upper left-to-center, and position subcopy and command in a shorter right-hand column aligned near its baseline, so the entire upper region is one compact confident banner. Under it, the product transformation stretches almost full content width in one panoramic stage, flat terminal at left, file browser in center, and three smaller native output file labels at right: "AGENTS.md", ".claude/rules", ".codex/config.toml". Precisely counted simple connector lines show shared source feeding generated outputs. Native file labels are diagram geometry, no glowing effects. The stage visually owns more space than the copy. A substantial darker surface differentiates the demo while remaining elegant and legible. Step controls are a restrained row below with the active "sync" orange. The very next section starts below the wide stage, a quiet left-aligned heading and clean four-row interface index. Orange action surfaces always have dark text.
